how_to_apply: AVNL MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026 applications must be submitted offline. Follow the steps below to apply.
Download the application form and read the detailed terms and conditions available at https://avnl.co.in.
Fill in the application form completely and attach the required documents as per the instructions on the official website.
Send the completed application so that it reaches AVNL MTPF within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.
Address the application to: The Chief General Manager, Machine Tool Prototype Factory, Ordnance Estate, Ambarnath, Dist.-Thane, Maharashtra, Pin code - 421502.

This recruitment does not have an online application mode. The application form and detailed terms and conditions are available for download at https://avnl.co.in, and completed applications must be sent offline to the address above.
Any corrigendum or amendment to this advertisement will be published on the AVNL website only.
For queries, candidates can contact the HR Division, AVNL-AVNL MTPF at [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. What is MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Machine Tool Prototype Factory (MTPF), a unit of Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (AVNL), to engage the 61st Batch of Non-ITI and Ex-ITI Trade Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 162 vacancies are available, comprising 83 posts under Non-ITI trades and 79 posts under Ex-ITI trades.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no fixed last date mentioned in the notification. Applications must reach MTPF within 21 days from the date the advertisement was published.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification distinguishes between Non-ITI and Ex-ITI candidates but does not specify detailed educational qualifications. Candidates should check the official application form for full details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 15 and 24 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application, with age relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline using the form available at https://avnl.co.in, sent to the Chief General Manager, MTPF, Ambarnath, so that it reaches within 21 days of the advertisement's publication.
